summary: CR-2026-10-11-008 QA — Anonymous Coupon Validation, Two-Step Flow, Error Code Handling. Critical setup fix: REACT_APP_CRM_URL was pointing to production CRM (returns 401 without API key), updated to preprod CRM. All core coupon flows tested via injected cart items (preprod restaurant 689 has all items SOLD OUT and ordering unavailable, so direct add-to-cart not possible).

ui_bugs.issue: Error messages show CRM's raw 'detail' field instead of user-friendly errorMap messages. Code uses `data?.error?.detail || errorMap[data?.error?.code]` — detail takes precedence. TC-5 shows 'Minimum order value is Rs300.0' instead of 'Minimum order value not met for this coupon'. TC-7 shows 'Coupon not valid for channel dine_in' instead of 'This coupon is not valid for this order type'. Also affects step2 path at ~line 936.
ui_bugs.fix: Reverse priority: `errorMap[data?.error?.code] || data?.error?.detail || 'Coupon not valid'`. Apply same fix at line 936 (step2 error path).

env_issues.fixed: REACT_APP_CRM_URL updated from https://crm.mygenie.online/api (production, returns 401) to https://mygenie-crm-preprod.preview.emergentagent.com/api (preprod, returns 200 without API key). Test coupons STO-GENERIC-10, STO-GENERIC-MIN, STO-STANDARD, STO-DELIVERY, STO-ONCE all verified present on preprod CRM.
